important_semantics: Queue membership indicates need for identity-resolution/remediation review; it is not an exclusion decision.
Pair count is used only to prioritize remediation impact after identity diagnostics were frozen.
The queue does not alter the frozen 34,789-record source population.
The queue does not decide temporal, language, or fiction-scope eligibility.
selection_rule: Human-reviewed project flagged as HETEROGENEOUS_CLUSTER, UNCERTAIN, or NONWORK_OR_HEADING_ARTIFACT when that flag is not already represented by the LLM project status.
